findings.title: Unguarded Privileged State Write
findings.evidence_cypher: MATCH p = (e:Function {is_entry: true, guarded: false})-[:CALLS*1..6]->(t:Function {id: $id}) WITH p, length(p) AS len RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path ORDER BY len LIMIT 3
findings.explanation: Unguarded Privileged State Write found affecting Treasury._grant(address). Attacker reachable call path: Treasury.handOver(address) -> Treasury._grant(address). Severity is High.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an access-control modifier such as onlyOwner to the entry function of the path.

findings.title: Reentrancy Vulnerability
findings.evidence_cypher: MATCH p = (e:Function {is_entry: true, guarded: false})-[:CALLS*1..6]->(t:Function {id: $id}) WITH p, length(p) AS len RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path ORDER BY len LIMIT 3
findings.explanation: Reentrancy Vulnerability found affecting Treasury.withdraw(uint256). Attacker reachable call path: Treasury.withdraw(uint256). Severity is High.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the state update before the external call (checks-effects-interactions) or add a reentrancy guard.

findings.title: Unchecked Low-Level Call
findings.evidence_cypher: MATCH p = (e:Function {is_entry: true, guarded: false})-[:CALLS*1..6]->(t:Function {id: $id}) WITH p, length(p) AS len RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path ORDER BY len LIMIT 3
findings.explanation: Unchecked Low-Level Call found affecting Treasury.refund(uint256). Attacker reachable call path: Treasury.refund(uint256). Severity is Medium.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture the success flag of the low-level call and require that it is true.
